criteria.reason: The exercise overflow menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option during log mode.
Skipping prompts for confirmation with window.confirm before calling the endpoint.
The server endpoint marks each set in the selected week with status "skipped".
An exercise whose sets are all skipped displays a “Skipped” label before the completion-state logic.
The menu offers “Unskip Exercise”; the endpoint restores logged status to filled sets and the UI updates.
A POST endpoint handles skip and unskip for an exercise and rotation.
A new server test covers skipping all sets and unskipping while preserving logged values.
The diff adds no client test for the skip UI.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
The added UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
